title: Follow the signal
prompt: A mobile app needs to show each learner their progress while keeping rewards trustworthy. Identify which Firebase service verifies identity, how Firestore checks ownership, and where the 10-point reward should be awarded. Tap Complete Challenge when you can explain all three.
hints: Start with Firebase Authentication. Think about which verified identifier stays the same when a learner signs in again.
Compare the authenticated UID with the UID in the Firestore document path. Ask what a rule should do when they differ.
Put the reward decision in a callable Cloud Function. A Firestore transaction can check whether progress was already completed before it records the reward.
